messages:
emily.cs: FYI customer Brightwave opened a support case: missing audit exports + 500s on API during window 2025-11-17 02:00-02:45 UTC. They want scope, whether KMS/HSM involved, and timeline. Case #12345. tagging SRE/Legal @alex.ops @sre_oncall @legal

alex.ops: Thanks — investigating. Which org id and any sample error ids?

emily.cs: Org: org_9Z4T7. Sample from customer: 'request_id=abc-123, endpoint=/v1/complete, status=500, time=2025-11-17T02:14:32Z' Also they say exported audit .json for that timeframe is missing from their export bucket.

sre_oncall: Seeing an ingress spike & 500 rate from 02:12–02:31 UTC. Traces point to backend timeouts while export job also ran. No app-level KMS errors in service logs so far. Querying infra logs now.

kevin.m: Legal note: if audit logs are missing or inaccessible for that org we may have to notify per SLA. Need to determine if logs were deleted vs failed export. Also did any KMS rotation occur around that time?

ingrid.sec: HSM/KMS rotation activity: rotation started 2025-11-16T23:55Z, completed 2025-11-17T01:05Z (scheduled manual rotation by ops_admin). Rotation itself targeted master key; export service should use data key alias. Will check key policies and recent policy changes.

alex.ops: Running S3/export job logs: found failure for audit-export/org_9Z4T7/2025-11-17T02:14.json — error: AccessDenied. Snippet: ```Error: AccessDenied
Operation: PutObject
Bucket: audits-export-prod
Key: audit-export/org_9Z4T7/2025-11-17T02:14.json
Cause: KMS:Decrypt failed for cmk-0a1b2c3d
``` 

emily.cs: Customer asking: "Were our logs deleted or just not exported?" and "When will we have the export?"

sre_oncall: Quick repro: re-run export job with the export role -> it fails with AccessDenied when attempting KMS decrypt for the old key ARN. Looks like export role is still referencing the pre-rotation key ARN.

kevin.m: Who performed the rotation and how was aliasing handled? If role references an explicit key ARN instead of alias that explains it. We need chain-of-custody for rotation and an evidence pack.

ingrid.sec: Confirmed: rotation was manual (ops_admin). The intended process is to switch the alias after new key creation, but the export role policy still had the old key ARN in the condition. I'll open a remediation ticket to update the role to allow the new key alias and re-run exports.

audits-bot: Export job queued for re-run (job_id=exp-7890). Waiting on role/policy fix.

emily.cs: Customer also wants ETA for when they'll see the missing files. What's realistic?

alex.ops: Plan: 1) update role policy to accept new key alias (~30–60m), 2) re-run backfill for the 02:00–03:00 window (job depends on queue size, estimate 2–3h), 3) verification and attestation (audit pack) (~<24h total). So preliminary update in 1 hour, tangible restore within ~4 hours, full evidence pack within 24h.

legal: That's acceptable for an interim customer notification. We must avoid definitive language about root cause until postmortem. Draft message: "We're investigating an export access issue likely related to key rotation. Preliminary ETA: export restore within 24 hours; we'll provide an update within 4 hours." Include contact for escalations and note we're preparing an audit evidence pack.

emily.cs: I'll send that provisional update to Brightwave now.

sre_oncall: Action items for follow-up: - @ingrid.sec update role/policy and confirm new key alias permissions - @alex.ops re-run exp-7890 and verify files in bucket - @audits-bot assemble evidence pack once files present.

ingrid.sec: Started policy change, pushing minimal-perm update to avoid broad perms. Patch deployed to staging, rolling to prod in ~25m. Will post IAM diff. :hammer_and_wrench:

alex.ops: After patch I'll kick the backfill. Will post logs and S3 paths when done.

emily.cs: Customer replied: "Thanks — please confirm when export available and we'll verify." Sending internal ETA note. :white_check_mark:

legal: Keep me in the loop for final wording. We may need to include rotation activity timestamps in the compliance notification.

sre_oncall: Current status: role patched in prod at 2060012000, backfill started at 2060012100. Monitoring.

emily.cs: Noted — I'll schedule the 4h update.

alex.ops: Backfill completed for org_9Z4T7 slice at 2060012350. Files: s3://audits-export-prod/audit-export/org_9Z4T7/2025-11-17T02:00-02:30.json (and subsequent parts). Doing checksum compare, looks good.

emily.cs: Sending the files to the customer and closing the immediate support case pending their verification.

legal: Please archive the rotation audit logs and include the HSM key rotation evidence in the evidence pack. We'll follow up on a postmortem to capture process gaps.

ingrid.sec: Will attach key rotation runbook + IAM diff in the evidence pack.

emily.cs: Customer confirmed receipt and verified logs. Closing case. Thanks all. :tada:
